name: Measurement significance code
description: Code specifying the significance of a measurement.

values.name: Approximately
values.description: Approximately The measurement is approximately equal to that specified.

values.name: Equal to
values.description: Equal to The measurement is equal to that specified.

values.name: Greater than or equal to
values.description: Greater than or equal to The measurement is greater than or equal to that specified.

values.name: Greater than
values.description: Greater than The measurement is greater than that specified.

values.name: Less than
values.description: Less than The measurement is less than that specified.

values.name: Less than or equal to
values.description: Less than or equal to The measurement is less than or equal to that specified.

values.name: Average value
values.description: Average value Average value for a specific series of readings.

values.name: Not equal to
values.description: Not equal to The measurement is not equal to that specified.

values.name: True value
values.description: True value The measurement reported is a true value.

values.name: Observed value
values.description: Observed value The measurement reported is an observed value.

values.name: Marked
values.description: Marked The measurement marked on the object.

values.name: Out of range
values.description: Out of range The measurement reported is out of range.
